WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: sleepy
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Gets tired faster than others.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: kind instinct
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: High in trait agreeableness and are very conscientious. They rarely insult others and will sometimes offer kind words to brighten the moods of those around them. They also never judge people by their appearance.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: violence disabled
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Emotionally and mentally incapable of engaging in violence. They are overwhelmingly resistant to and horrified by the idea of hurting another.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: indoor dweller
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Doesn't mind staying indoors for as long as needed.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: heat tolerant
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Can tolerate higher temperatures better than average.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: cold tolerant
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Can tolerate lower temperatures better than average.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: attractive
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Emits a natural beauty.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: low libido
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a lower-than-average interest in sexual activity.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: high libido
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a higher-than-average interest in sexual activity.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: coward
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: More likely to cower, hide, or break down under frightening pressure.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: brave
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: More resilient to stress and more likely to face danger with composure.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: angelic beauty
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Possesses an almost pristine beauty that strongly affects how others see them.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: repulsive
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a deeply unsettling appearance that strongly harms social impressions.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: larger
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a larger body. Moves and works more slowly, is easier to spot while hunting, and is worse at dodging, but hits harder in melee, carries more, takes less incoming damage, and produces more mass, meat, and leather.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: smaller
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a smaller body. Moves and works faster, is harder to spot while hunting, and dodges better, but has less mass, carries less, hits less reliably in melee, and produces less meat and leather.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: table indifferent
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Does not mind eating without a table.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: clean
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Naturally produces less filth during daily activity.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: filthy
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Naturally produces more filth during daily activity.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: stinky
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Produces an unpleasant smell that bothers nearby people.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: thalassophobia
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has an intense fear of water and may panic near bodies of water, marsh, or exposed rain.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: volatile
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Experiences unpredictable mood shifts from day to day.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: reduced fertility
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a reduced chance of becoming pregnant or impregnating others.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: rowdy
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Likes rough play fighting, whether or not the other person appreciates it.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: enforcer
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is naturally better at bringing unruly people under control and making arrests.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: guttural voice
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Speaks with a harsh, throat-heavy voice.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: growling voice
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Speaks with a growling, snarling voice with animalistic undertones.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: reclusive
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Feels happier in a smaller faction and less comfortable in a crowded one.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: mechaphobia
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a deep fear of mechanoids and may collapse when they are nearby, even allied ones.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: gravship affinity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Performs especially well aboard gravships, with improved coordination, perception, and technical aptitude in zero gravity.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: chest fur
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Grows thick fur on the chest.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: territorial
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Feels calmer at home and increasingly uneasy when away from their own land.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: nocturnal
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Prefers being awake at night, gaining mood at night and losing mood during daytime wakefulness.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: arrogant
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Speaks without much filter, often saying things that rub others the wrong way.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: flirty
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Offers playful, affectionate words that can brighten moods and deepen bonds, but may also spark romances and breakups.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: shooting curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning shooting fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: melee curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning melee fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: construction curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning construction fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning mining fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: cooking curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning cooking fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: plants curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning plants fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: animals curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning animals fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: crafting curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning crafting fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: artistic curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning artistic fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: medicine curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning medical fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: social curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning social fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: intellectual curiosity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Finds learning intellectual fun and does not lose the skill over time.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: extended memory
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Remembers good and bad events for longer and loses skills more slowly.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: narrow memory
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Forgets good and bad events sooner and loses skills more quickly.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: intimidating presence
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has a threatening presence that makes slaves more likely to listen.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: silvertongued
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Speaks persuasively, improving social convincing and barter.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: materialistic
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Craves more and richer goods, becoming unhappy when those desires are not met.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: pushover
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is slowed much more by pain and injury.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: hotheaded
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is more volatile and impulsive, with violent outbursts occurring more often.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: rough play
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: May accidentally hurt partners during lovin' due to a larger body and rougher manner, but will make them happier.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: naturalist
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Prefers to keep skin uncovered rather than wear clothing or armor.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: mental fanaticism
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Develops extreme zeal, making negotiation much harder.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: nuzzle
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Periodically seeks out other colonists for affectionate nuzzling.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: carnivore
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Prefers meat, gains less nutrition from plant foods, and can become unwell from eating too much vegetable matter.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: herbivore
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Prefers plant food, gains less nutrition from animal products, and can become unwell from eating too much meat or animal products.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: cathermal
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Sleeps in frequent short naps rather than following a normal day-night rhythm.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: afamilial
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Forms weaker emotional bonds with family members, including parents and children.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: greedy
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is strongly motivated by material wealth.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: abrasive
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Has trouble minding words and anticipating others' reactions.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: recluse
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Feels comfortable alone and stressed by large groups of people.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: hoarder
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Feels happiest with belongings piled nearby and moves cleanly through cluttered spaces.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: motion sickness
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Becomes weak and miserable for a while after high-speed travel such as drop pods, shuttles, or gravships.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: parroting
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Compulsively mimics social interactions, responding in kind to what others say or do.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: route memory
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Remembers paths, shortcuts, and safe crossings, making familiar caravan routes faster.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: extreme cold climate preference
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is comfortable only in extremely cold climates and can suffer badly in warmer ones.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: cold climate preference
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is comfortable only in colder climates and can suffer badly in warmer ones.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: hot climate preference
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is comfortable only in warmer climates and can suffer badly in colder ones.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: extreme hot climate preference
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Is comfortable only in extremely hot climates and can suffer badly in colder ones.
